emails.subject: Q4 priorities
emails.body:
Hi all,

Our Q4 sales target is $1,470,000. The three priorities are the Riverbend Schools RFP, on-time delivery for healthcare customers, and keeping supplier costs flat. Alex will run the weekly pipeline review on Mondays.

Avery

emails.subject: Ergo Supplies Q4 catalog
emails.body:
Hi Alex,

Our Q4 catalog is live. The EC-200 task chair is $315 per unit for orders of 30 or more. Details: https://www.ergosupplies.example/products/ec-200

Best,
Dana Whitfield
Ergo Supplies

emails.subject: Warehouse space for Ergo shipment
emails.body:
Hi Casey,

We are about to order 36 EC-200 chairs from Ergo Supplies. Can you hold two pallet bays in the warehouse for the week of Nov 2?

Thanks,
Alex

emails.subject: Order PO-4387: 36 EC-200 chairs
emails.body:
Hi Dana,

Please process purchase order PO-4387 for 36 EC-200 task chairs at $315 each, delivered to our San Jose warehouse.

Thanks,
Alex Morgan
Northwind

emails.subject: Re: Order PO-4387: 36 EC-200 chairs
emails.body:
Hi Alex,

Confirmed. Your Ergo order number is ES-13136 and it is scheduled to ship by Nov 3. You can check status any time at https://www.ergosupplies.example/order-status?order=ES-13136

Dana

emails.subject: Quote request: 12 standing desks
emails.body:
Hello Alex,

Eriksen Dental is refitting our front office. Could you quote 12 electric standing desks with delivery in November?

Samuel Eriksen
Office Manager

emails.subject: Re: Quote request: 12 standing desks
emails.body:
Hi Samuel,

The quote for 12 electric standing desks, delivered and installed, is $12,700. The full quote is attached. We can deliver the week of Nov 2.

Best,
Alex

emails.subject: Q4 budget review
emails.body:
Hi Alex,

Could you check the sales operations lines in the Q4 budget before Thursday? Travel looks high to me.

Morgan

emails.subject: Open enrollment closes Nov 13
emails.body:
Hi everyone,

Benefits open enrollment closes on Nov 13. The handbook in the drive has the plan summaries.

Priya

emails.subject: Brightline studio refit timeline
emails.body:
Hi Jamie,

We would like the new workstations installed on Nov 13 so the studio is ready for our December projects. Can Northwind make that date?

Mei Tanaka
Brightline Studio

emails.subject: Scheduled maintenance this Saturday
emails.body:
Hi all,

The order portal and VPN will be down on Saturday Oct 31 from 08:00 to 12:00 for maintenance.

Drew

emails.subject: FastFreight pickup scheduled
emails.body:
Hi Alex,

Pickup at Ergo Supplies is booked for Nov 4. Your tracking number is FF1850740: https://www.fastfreight.example/track?id=FF1850740

Ken Adams
FastFreight

emails.subject: Contract redlines: master supply agreement
emails.body:
Alex,

Attached are our redlines on the supply agreement. The main change is a 60-day payment term instead of 30.

Omar Haddad
Haddad Legal

emails.subject: Re: Q4 budget review
emails.body:
Hi Morgan,

Travel includes the Riverbend site visits; I can cut it by 20 percent if we move the Novak meeting to the showroom. I updated the budget sheet.

Alex

emails.subject: Interview request for Office Trends Weekly
emails.body:
Hi Alex,

I am writing a piece on how distributors handle supply delays. Would you have 20 minutes on Nov 6 for a short interview?

Nora Quinn
Office Trends Weekly

emails.subject: Customer case study draft
emails.body:
Hi Alex,

I drafted a case study on the Pinecrest Clinic project for the newsletter. Could you check the numbers before Monday?

Jordan

emails.subject: Pipeline meeting today at 10
emails.body:
Hi Alex,

Reminder that the pipeline meeting is at 10 in the main room. I will bring the Riverbend numbers.

Jamie

emails.subject: Pipeline meeting notes, Nov 2
emails.body:
Hi all,

The notes from today's pipeline meeting are in the drive. Main actions: Jamie owns the Riverbend RFP response, Riley follows up with Novak Architects, and I confirm the Ergo delivery date.

Alex

emails.subject: Pinecrest Clinic: delivery window
emails.body:

Our clinic is only closed on Saturday mornings. Could the chair delivery happen on Saturday Nov 7 between 08:00 and 11:00?

Grace Liu
Pinecrest Clinic

emails.body:
Hi Riley,

Could we borrow two sample EC-200 chairs for a week before we decide on the full order?

emails.subject: Shipment update for ES-13136

Hi Alex,

Your order ES-13136 is packed and will leave our warehouse with FastFreight on Nov 4, one day later than planned.

Dana

Hannah Becker
Facilities Director

Alex

emails.body:
Will do. I will have them in the draft by Friday morning.

Alex
